Name: Matching Pam Sprite
Author: badboyzay
Description:
There are many things that aren't quite right with Pam's sprite: It shows her wearing a tank top while she is wearing a jacket in her portrait, her nose looks bad when she's sideway and her hair looks weird in the back. This mod will give her the jacket so her sprite resembles her portrait better, also changed her nose so she looks consistent with the rest of characters sprite, her back of hair also looks more consistent with the front now.

[b]How to install:
[/b]Simply put the content in your Stardew Valley folder.

[b]Permission:
[/b]You are free to do whatever you want with my mods as long as you credit me.
